CLASS: B.TECH   SEMESTER:  III
BRANCH: EEE   SESSION : MO/2019

SUBJECT : EE203 ELECTRICAL ENERGY GENERATION & CONTROL

TIME: 2:00  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 25.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 25 marks.
3. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
4. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) In Indian perspective, discuss the evolution of grid interconnection and three major
reasons behind low per capita energy consumption.
[2]
 (b) Discuss with complete layout, the steam generating plant and its different components.  [3]


Q2 (a) Discuss Counter flow Jet condenser with neat diagram. [2]
 (b) A domestic lighting installation having 15 Nos. of 60 W bulbs are operated as follows:
5 lamps    from  6PM to 8PM
10 lamps  from  8PM to 10 PM
6 lamps    from  10 PM to 12 Midnight
Determine the maximum demand, average demand, diversity factor and load factor. Also
draw the load curve and load duration curve.
[3]


Q3 (a) Describe the operation of Throttle governing of steam turbine under different loading
conditions in a power system.
[2]
 (b) Explain with a neat diagram construction and working of Babcock and Wilcox water tube
boiler.
[3]


Q4 (a) Illustrate the statement, “Hydro power projects are used as base as well as peak load
power plants.”
[2]
 (b) A hydro-electric power station has a reservoir of area 2·4 square kilometers and capacity
5 × 106 cubic meter. The net head of water utilized at the turbine is 100 m. The head
loss  due  to  friction  is  5  m.  The  penstock,  turbine  and  generation  efficiencies  are
respectively 95%, 90% and 85%.
(i) Calculate the total electrical energy that can be generated from the power station.
(ii) If a load of 15,000 kW has been supplied for 3 hours, find the fall in reservoir level.
[3]


Q5 (a) Explain cavitation problem in water turbine. Also discuss the functionality of surge tank
in hydro power projects.
[2]
 (b) Discuss the operation of Medium head hydro turbine with neat diagram and explain its
different components.
[3]
